summary: Man sustained a leg laceration from a nail near the Peter Rabbit Hut; GCSAR carried him down to a waiting ambulance.
location: Peter Rabbit Hut, near Current Creek, Grand County
notes: Paged 2:30am 2020-07-15; carried down to ambulance by 5:30am. Leg laceration from a nail; unable to walk out. Grand County Sheriff's Office and Grand County EMS - Mountain Medical Response Team assisted.
